Intro

Wellbutrin (Bupropion) is atypical antidepressant medication that is used in the treatment of depression and in smoking cessation.

It works by blocking the reuptake of norepinephrine and dopamine, leading to higher levels of these neurotransmitters available in the neurons synapse

In this video, I will explain the side effects of this medication

Ragesoss assumed (based on copyright claims)., Public domain, via Wikimedia Commons

Cardiovascular side effects

Tachycardia and Higher blood pressure

Higher norepinephrine levels lead to activation of the sympathetic system (fight or flight response) leading to tachycardia and higher blood pressure

YitzhakNat, CC BY-SA 4.0 <https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0>, via Wikimedia Commons

Central nervous system

Insomnia: higher dopamine levels stimulate the brain leading to increase alertness and energy levels leading to insomnia

Headache: changes in neurotransmitter levels can affect brain chemistry leading to headache

Anxiety and agitation: higher levels of norepinephrine and dopamine may lead to anxiety and agitation

https://www.myupchar.com/en, CC BY-SA 4.0 <https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0>, via Wikimedia Commons

GIT side effects

Nausea and vomiting

That is because Increased norepinephrine levels also affects the enteric nervous system leading to nausea, vomiting

Also Elevated norepinephrine levels may stimulate the chemoreceptor trigger zone in the brain leading to nausea and vomiting

Respiratory side effects

Rhinitis

Pharyngitis

Diaphoresis

Excessive sweating

Caused by increased body temperature caused by the elevations in norepinephrine levels

Egon Eagle, Public domain, via Wikimedia Commons

Dry mouth

Higher norepinephrine levels lead to activation of the sympathetic system (fight or flight response) leading to dry mouth

Tremor (jitteriness)

Caused by sympathetic nervous system activation

Weight loss

Higher dopamine levels lead to stimulant effect that can suppress the appetite leading to less food intake and weight loss

Hepatotoxicity

Bupropion is metabolized in the liver and in some cases it may cause damage to the liver

Symptoms include yellow, skin and eye, itching, upper abdominal pain and dark urine

Laboratoires Servier, CC BY-SA 3.0 <https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0>, via Wikimedia Commons

Ophthalmologic

Higher risk of Triggering closed angle glaucoma attack

On the other hand, it mya decrease the risk of development of open angle glaucoma

Seizures

Bupropion Lowers seizure threshold because it alters neurotransmitters concentrations in the brain

The effect is highly dose dependent

Higher suicide risk

Worsening suicidal ideation especially in people younger than 25 years old

Psychosis

Hallucinations and delusions

Because it increases the levels of dopamine in the brain

Trigger mania or hypomania

Especially in patients with bipolar disorders

Chris martin, CC3.0 via Wikimedia commons

Withdrawal syndrome

Occur where there is abrupt interruptions or sudden withdrawal of the medication

Symptoms include dizziness, insomnia, anxiety, agitation and irritability
